2588.text: What do you want, $c? I'm running late, and my employer doesn't look kindly on tardiness.

2824.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.
2824.text1: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

3337.text: Another Herbalist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.
3337.text1: Another Herbalist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.

3341.text: I don't get too many cooks in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.
3341.text1: I don't get too many cooks in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

3344.text: I don't get too many Skinners in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.
3344.text1: I don't get too many Skinners in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

3369.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.
3369.text1: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

3374.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.
3374.text1: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

3379.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?
3379.text1: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

4139.text: Welcome to Blue Moon Odds and Ends, $c.  If you have any questions, please let me know.

4965.text: My brother said we could make great money with this trade route, but he didn't tell me I would be the one living on this side. If you come back this way on the Zeppelin, could you bring me something to eat? They sell some of the finest meat in Orgrimmar, and I sure could use something that didn't die weeks before it stopped moving.
4965.text1: My brother said we could make great money with this trade route, but he didn't tell me I would be the one living on this side. If you come back this way on the Zeppelin, could you bring me something to eat? They sell some of the finest meat in Orgrimmar, and I sure could use something that didn't die weeks before it stopped moving.

7217.text: Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, $c. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.$B$BIf you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.$B$BBut there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

7251.text: Looking to learn how to use a new weapon?  Find Sayoc and Hanashi inside Arms of Legend in the Valley of Honor.
7251.text1: Looking to learn how to use a new weapon?  Find Sayoc and Hanashi inside Arms of Legend in the Valley of Honor.

7257.text: Archibald who you look for.  He outside weapon merchant shop on inner ring of War Quarter.

7707.text1: Nice to see a friendly face. I don't get much chitchat from Apothecary Johaan unless he wants something. He's been out of the grave too long. Someday I'll be like that, I hear. Creepy. Maybe by then I won't care.

7710.text: Once, it is true, I was human. What might otherwise be a shortcoming works to our advantage, $n, for I know human weaknesses intimately.

8062.text: Life is like a carefully woven tapestry.

8094.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

8095.text: How may I be of service?

8096.text: Greetings, and welcome.  I am not very good at smiling, but trust me; I am happy to serve you.

8122.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

8185.text: Yes, I've been running this shop for some time now. Business has been pretty good lately. A lot of new adventurers coming through...

8296.text: It is wise that you humble yourself before me $n in your desire for more warlock knowledge.
8296.text1: It is wise that you humble yourself before me $n in your desire for more warlock knowledge.

8402.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.
8402.text1: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

8406.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?
8406.text1: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

8810.text: Here to learn how to wield a new weapon, or just to waste my time?

8862.text: Heya mon.  You come right place learn how ta wield a new weapon.

8873.text: I suppose you are here to be trained in the use of a new weapon?  Make it fast, I'm very busy!

9685.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!
9685.text1: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

9688.text: I can teach you how to cook!
9688.text1: I can teach you how to cook!

9701.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.
9701.text1: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

9893.text: You there... it is in your best interest to aid the Forsaken during these dire times.  Listen closely, as I dislike repeating myself.$B$BWe currently find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  Bandages and simple textiles are running low, and donations are being accepted to bolster sagging inventories.  While you'll not receive financial compensation - hence what donation means - your aid will not go unnoticed.

9894.text: Friend - Stormwind needs your assistance and your generosity!$B$BOur once large stockpile of textiles has run critically low.  Stormwind is now engaged in a multi-pronged effort to rebuild those stocks for the manufacture of textiles and bandages!  Your donation of cloth would help Stormwind immensely, as well as earn the respect of the citizenry!

292463.text1:
Why do they call me "The Breaker"?

Trust me, you don't want to know.

296783.text: The Dark Lady has put the challenge forth. Now it is up to the Royal Apothecary Society to develop a new plague. We shall bring Arthas and his wretched army to their knees.

299234.text1: Praise to the Banshee Queen, it isn't often I have visitors out here.

300626.text1: Greetings, $c. Do you come seeking the blessings of the Windlord?

300661.text: Ho there, traveler! New to town? Well, once you get settled in, come see me if you'd like some work. I've been working overtime preparing for the Festival of Winds and I'll take all the help I can get keeping the larders full!

300662.text: If you need training as a cook, I have a few tips and tricks I could pass on! Ho ho! Throw on an apron and let's get started!

300665.text1: I'm in charge of Shen'dar Village operations, and there's a lot of things to keep track of around here. Between bandits, cultists, and other random incidents that pop up, keeping this village afloat is a lot of work.

300678.text1: <Constable Aonda wears an intense look on her face, clearly deep in thought.>

300698.text: I can teach you to craft fine leather armor, if you have the aptitude.

300702.text1:
The clothcraft of the Shen'dorei is a harmonious imitation of the flowing, carefree currents of the winds. While the spirits have left us, and I know not when I may see them dance once more... I find great comfort in my art, if only as a distraction.

I can teach you to work the cloth as well, if you'd like to learn?

300714.text: <The corpse lying before you is covered in scorches and burn marks. He seems to be clutching something in his hand.>
300714.text1: <The corpse lying before you is covered in scorches and burn marks. He seems to be clutching something in his hand.>

301009.text:
Greetings, young $c. Welcome to the hall of the Tradesman's Guild. Resources are tight on Zephras right now, but you should be able to find a variety of materials and wares here to keep you in top adventuring form.

Please let me know if you have any questions.
301009.text1:
Greetings, young $c. Welcome to the hall of the Tradesman's Guild. Resources are tight on Zephras right now, but you should be able to find a variety of materials and wares here to keep you in top adventuring form.

Please let me know if you have any questions.

301019.text: Come, young one, sit with me.

301020.text: The pylons that keep our island home anchored to the elemental plane of Skywall are failing. Zephras Isle--our home--is in grave danger.

301021.text: The Al'Aketh cult continues to escalate their violence, and the Windshapers stubbornly refuse to recognize the inaction that brought us here.

301022.text: The High Order are the custodians of the highborne ways, and we will master the magic holding this island in place and bend it to our will.

301023.text: The future is uncertain, but there is opportunity in this. We will rediscover the self-reliance that drove us before we came to this place.

301024.text: It was a critical mistake that our people left their fates in the hands of fickle elemental spirits. It's up to us now to remedy that error.

301040.text1: If you are looking for more work, I'm sure there are some folks in town that are also looking for help with one task or another. Just ask around, you are bound to find something.

301044.text:
Hello there, young $c. I am Rathiril Sunlance and I am an elder Magister of the High Order here on Zephras Isle. It's always good to see bright-eyed young shen'dorei, ready to do their duty in service to their homeland.

Don't let this dusty old mage hold you up, however. No doubt you've got many adventures to see to. Feel free to stop by later if you'd like to speak more.

301355.text: My wife and I run the stormapple orchard in the lowlands, just to the west of Valanaar.

301356.text: Some years ago our farm was attacked by bandits. They took everything we had and left me bruised and bloody. The next season around the same time, they returned.

301357.text: They took most of our harvest again, but this time the bandit leader--Ferauu "the Bludgeon" as he's known--told us that every season they'd return and take twice as much as the previous year.

301358.text: We tried to petition the peacekeepers to come and help drive the bandits off, but they are stretched too thin just dealing with the cult and couldn't spare anyone.

301359.text: This year our yield is light and we can't hope to give them what they expect. The best case is that they simply kill us quickly. It's more likely they take everything we have and leave us to starve.

301362.text: I came to town to hire fighters to drive them off. I found one warrior who agreed to help, but he robbed me as soon as we were out of town and nearly beat me to death.

301364.text: At this point I'm too injured to leave this bed. I'm begging you, stranger. Travel to my orchard. Tell Aamelia what happened and help her survive this somehow. Please, stranger... help us.

301455.text: <The man lying before you shifts uncomfortably. He's recovering from some very nasty wounds.>

301456.text: It's always great to see you, $n.

301472.text: If you've spoken with Rathiril and he sent you to see me, you are no doubt aware of the peril we find ourselves in.

301473.text: The High Order seeks to find a pragmatic and enlightened solution to our current crisis.

301474.text: One that does not rely upon divine intervention from external forces. We seek to master our own destiny for the first time since we've arrived in Skywall.

301475.text: Since we left our homes in Kalimdor, the world has grown. They call it "Azeroth" now and it's a massive, vibrant world.

301476.text: Recently we discovered a way to use our magic to carve a "keyhole" of sorts to peer through the planes to learn much of Azeroth.

301478.text: When we peered through that keyhole, someone else peered back--members of a magical order much like our own, called the Kirin Tor. We have learned much from them.

301480.text: The elementals who brought us here are gone. Any feats they used to maintain our homes can be replicated with highborne magic, but our powers have grown weak in Skywall.

301481.text: Some among us must leave this plane of existence. We must travel to Azeroth to rediscover what we've lost, and bring that knowledge back as a tool to save our home.

301482.text: The Kirin Tor have graciously agreed to receive us as their guests, and we will need their help if we are to succeed.

301483.text: We will need explorers and adventurers of all kinds. Think on this, and when the time comes, I hope you will consider joining us. Until then, good fortune to you.

301874.text: It is encouraging to know that Elaadrin and his mages are finally with us. With both the High Order and the Windshapers working with us against the greater threat, we stand a much better chance to thwart the Al'Aketh and whatever they have planned for Valanaar.

301876.text: Oh, and for you in particular, $c. I heard of the altercation you had at the standing stones with the Windshapers...

301877.text: There may yet be a reckoning for that. In the meantime, I hope that both the Windshapers and the High Order can agree that the Al'Aketh are the greater threat to Zephras and set all else aside.

301916.text: <This cultist is dead. Upon close inspection, you notice that he seems to be clutching something to his chest, almost as if he was protecting it.>
301916.text1: <This cultist is dead. Upon close inspection, you notice that he seems to be clutching something to his chest, almost as if he was protecting it.>

302063.text1: With the cult running roughshod over most of the island with impunity, Lorthuna undoubtedly thinks we are on the back foot. We can use that overconfidence against her.

302064.text1: I believe that with a proper distraction at the shrine, a small force of Peacekeepers, Windshapers, and High Order should be able to push up a flank and break into the inner sanctum. From there, we take out the High Priestess herself and cut the head off the snake.

302065.text1: Go and speak with the leaders of the Windshapers and the High Order, respectively. They don't get along, but I think they can recognize that the bigger threat is the Al'Aketh. Get them to agree to the plan and then return here.

302070.text1:
<Ayessa Dawnsinger eyes you with barely-contained fury.> 

You are either very bold, or very stupid to so brazenly step foot into our domain after spilling Windshaper blood. We are slow to forgive, and we never forget. 

You should remove yourself from here at once. If we weren't in the center of Zephras, you would already be dead.

302073.text1:
Hmm, I see. Very well then, $c. The Windshapers will provide aid. Please inform Valennia that she can count on us for this fight.

<Ayessa lowers her voice dangerously.> 

Do not mistake our cooperation for any sort of forgiveness. You owe the Windshapers blood, and someday we will collect.

302079.text: Greetings, I am Elaadrin Evengale, the current Supreme Magister of the High Order. How can I help you?

302085.text:
The Windshapers are almost wholly to blame for everything that has happened. Their refusal to change has damaged our ability to save ourselves from our current peril. They speak in absolutes and treat assumptions and superstitious hope as fact.

Do you know who else deals only in absolutes? The Al'Aketh. 

I for one do not intend to let blind adherence to dangerous beliefs doom our people. If it weren't for the threat of the cult, I'd march our mages over to the other side of Valanaar and wipe the Windshapers out.

302087.text:
I see. This seems dangerous in the extreme, but the situation seems to demand that risks be taken.

Very well, the High Order will provide aid. Please inform Valennia that she can count on us for this fight.

302093.text:
The Peacekeepers can't hope to muster the numbers needed for an outright assault on the shrine. Without the Windshapers and the High Order bolstering our numbers, we stand no chance. They both pledged their aid when we need it. Now is the time.

Unfortunately, some recent events have led to outright bloodshed between the two factions, and tensions are high.

How do you feel about a bit of diplomacy?
302093.text1:
The Peacekeepers can't hope to muster the numbers needed for an outright assault on the shrine. Without the Windshapers and the High Order bolstering our numbers, we stand no chance. They both pledged their aid when we need it. Now is the time.

Unfortunately, some recent events have led to outright bloodshed between the two factions, and tensions are high.

How do you feel about a bit of diplomacy?

302159.text1: <Valennia is severely wounded and is barely holding on to consciousness.>

302160.text1:
Most of the cultists at the Sanctum of Storms seem to have come out to respond to our attack. I never would have expected this to go so well. This was almost too easy...

I think that the Windshapers and High Order have made their push. Valennia should be with them. You should head inside and find her. We'll stay here and keep watch while Valennia and the others finish what they came here to do.

302443.text: We came as soon as we were told what was happening. The High Order is here to serve Zephras.

302444.text1: ...and the Windshapers. We are ready to support an assault on the Shrine, Valennia.

302445.text1: You have my thanks. Being truthful, however, this is going to be a dangerous gambit and we may not succeed. It's important you understand that this might be a one-way ride.

302446.text1: We understand. As it happens Elaadrin and I spoke. We made arrangements to send for... outside aid. It's unclear if they will be able to arrive in time to help, or if they will even arrive at all...

302447.text1: Outside... of Zephras? From the other provinces? We haven't had contact with the other islands for years...?

302448.text: It's... coming from a little further away than that. We'll explain on the way.

302449.text1: Very well then. Time is not with us so we should make ourselves ready. Thank you all for your aid. Zephras is in your debt.

302631.text1: Aonda is a good woman, and a true servant of Zephras Isle. It is my hope that you can quickly earn her trust and help her to keep Shen'dar Village safe. May the winds guide you, $n.

302649.text1: Go with the blessings of Al'Akir. But be warned; those that approach the Windlord's faithful under false pretense will quickly face His wrath.

302650.text: <The two cultists nearby are talking. You might be able to learn something if you hide behind this wardrobe and eavesdrop.>
302650.text1: <The two cultists nearby are talking. You might be able to learn something if you hide behind this wardrobe and eavesdrop.>

302705.text: I tell you lot, that forest is haunted! I SAW *hic* WHAT I SAW!

302706.text: If you don't believe me, go and see for yourself! Terrible windblown wraiths *hic*... forest spirits that will gnaw your ankles!

302707.text: There's even a terrible forest wraith! Dressed all in black and... evil looking! I tell you, it's a cursed place! *hic*

302807.text: If you have the aptitude for the druidic arts, I can train you.
302807.text1: If you have the aptitude for the druidic arts, I can train you.

302811.text:
The hunters and rangers of Zephras have never been more needed. The winds grow ever harsher, and the magic that sustains our island is fading. The wilds have never been more wild, and people like me are needed to keep our people safe.

If you have the proper aptitude as a hunter, I can give you the tools to survive the wilds.
302811.text1:
The hunters and rangers of Zephras have never been more needed. The winds grow ever harsher, and the magic that sustains our island is fading. The wilds have never been more wild, and people like me are needed to keep our people safe.

If you have the proper aptitude as a hunter, I can give you the tools to survive the wilds.

302814.text:
Slay your enemies and swoon your paramours with this one weird trick.

If you follow the path of the rogue, I can teach you... for a cost, of course.
302814.text1:
Slay your enemies and swoon your paramours with this one weird trick.

If you follow the path of the rogue, I can teach you... for a cost, of course.

302817.text: The warrior who flinches is the warrior who dies. If you would look death in the face as a warrior, I will teach you how not to flinch.
302817.text1: The warrior who flinches is the warrior who dies. If you would look death in the face as a warrior, I will teach you how not to flinch.

302824.text:
You might think that just because we live on a floating island, there would be no need for miners like me. After so many thousands of years, however, we still manage to dig up a lot of interesting things.

It's almost like there's some invisible force, constantly creating new mineral deposits every so often. That's magic for you though, right?

Regardless, if you need training as a miner, then I'm your shen'dorei.
302824.text1:
You might think that just because we live on a floating island, there would be no need for miners like me. After so many thousands of years, however, we still manage to dig up a lot of interesting things.

It's almost like there's some invisible force, constantly creating new mineral deposits every so often. That's magic for you though, right?

Regardless, if you need training as a miner, then I'm your shen'dorei.

303598.text1: Oh, and a word of warning before you head up to Shadowgale Forest. It's incredibly dangerous up there. Some even say it's haunted. Make sure you are prepared and well-equipped if you plan to make the trek.

303612.text: Welcome to the Calmbreeze Inn, traveler. Would you like some refreshment?
303612.text1: Welcome to the Calmbreeze Inn, traveler. Would you like some refreshment?

304010.text: What do you need of me, child of Zephras?

304013.text1:
I can tell by your aura that you are of highborne lineage, yes? Those that call themselves members of the High Order find very little common ground with the members of my order, the Windshapers. Outside the relative harmony of Thendal Grove, you may find that these divisions run very deep, deep enough to drive division and even violence.

Be mindful of this as you move throughout Zephras Isle. I'll offer you this one warning... do not cross the Windshapers.

304014.text: Greetings to you, fellow High Order initiate.

304291.text:
Lorthuna is performing some sort of ritual up there. She may be trying to bring down the wards!

The help we sent for has not yet arrived, but we'll just have to manage with what we have. When you are ready, let me know and we'll go confront her.

304299.text1: Lorthuna! Stop this madness. You don't know what bringing down the wards protecting Zephras will do. You could doom us all!

304303.text1: Ayessa... my former sister. How far you've fallen, keeping company with this High Order filth.

304304.text: I'll make this easy for you, witch. Stop what you are doing now and I will make your death swift. This is the last and best offer you will get from the High Order.

304307.text1: Bring the wards down? The wards have been down for days, fools. No, I am merely lighting a beacon... for the true servants of Al'Akir to follow.

304433.text1: Ahh... yes! The call has been answered. Meet your end with joy!

304441.text: Who dares call the Lord of the East Wind?

304443.text: So the rumors were true. My wayward brothers did well to conceal this place from the gaze of Al'Akir.

304445.text1: Yes! Yes! It is by my will that the way to Zephras is open to you! Bring me before your Windlord so that he may know who was the herald of his glory!

304447.text: You dare to command me, mortal? No, I think not. Begone, insignificant elf!

304448.text1: No! Never, I would never dare!

304449.text: Well, you certainly never will again, insect. Hah!

304452.text: Enjoy your remaining time as "guests" in my lord's realm until his judgement inevitably arrives. You'll know not when, but it is coming.

304454.text: Now that this wondrous realm is no longer hidden from us, you are going to enjoy getting to know the TRUE children of Skywall...

304558.text: Oh, enough of that crazy talk, swimmers. You are going to scare off the few customers we have with your drunken ghost stories!
304558.text1: Oh, enough of that crazy talk, swimmers. You are going to scare off the few customers we have with your drunken ghost stories!

304626.text1:
More than I'd like, I'm afraid. We've been harassed by a group of bandits camping out in a cave to the north, and the Al'Aketh cult recently took over Falaath Village to the south of us. I trust every peacekeeper and citizen here, but we are far too few to keep the village secure. 

If the cult decides to continue their expansion here, there's little we can do to stop them.

305036.text1:
Zephras is in a state of decline, unfortunately. The elemental wind spirits that brought us here to Skywall so many thousands of years ago have vanished, causing us to lose much of the magic on which we've depended for millennia.

The island itself is also dangerously unstable, and we've even lost contact with the other island provinces of the shen'dorei. The few Windshapers that still possess the gift of skysight have attempted to contact our brothers and sisters on the other islands, but we have had no response.

Many among us are worried that the shen'dorei here on Zephras are all that is left of our people.

305038.text1:
The shen'dorei will always owe the spirits a debt for their aid, and the Windshapers have sworn an oath to repay that debt and restore things to the way they were before. Unfortunately, we are dangerously blind to what is happening around us within Skywall without the spirits to guide us.

The High Order are shortsighted and arrogant, just like their highborne ancestors. They seek to master and control the magic of this place. This is the very path that led us to flee from Kalimdor and reside here in the first place. I fear that much like our forebears their confidence has vastly outpaced their competence and the end result could be disastrous.

305042.text:
Magic can accomplish almost anything, but stagnation and inaction have caused us to lose so much of ourselves in the thousands of years since we left Kalimdor. The High Order seeks to reclaim the Highborne heritage that we've left behind and become the masters of our own destiny once again.

The Windshapers think we are simply reckless and arrogant. Hypocrisy at its finest, if you ask me. The Windshapers will entertain no ideas but their own when it comes to this crisis. Who, I wonder, is truly arrogant?

305044.text:
Zephras is in great danger. The elemental wind spirits that brought us here to Skywall so many thousands of years ago have abandoned us, leaving us vulnerable in this unstable realm. Our once-robust society spanned multiple island sanctuaries in our corner of Skywall, but now we are not even sure if any other shen'dorei remain outside of this small island.

Things are dire, but the High Order is committed to rising to this challenge.

305106.text: Sorry that we are late, Ayessa.

305107.text: It took a bit of work to convince Archmage Rhonin to help me open that transplanar portal...

305108.text: Ansirem! This isn't how I expected our first meeting to go, but I'm glad you made it!

305109.text1: Nor is this how I envisioned our first meeting, Muln.

305110.text: Well if this isn't an inspirational sight. The little elves seem to have friends in... low places.

305111.text: We have no quarrel with you, Lord of the East Wind. Leave us in peace.

305112.text: Very well, mortals. For now enjoy your respite. I simply cannot wait to tell the Windlord about all that has transpired here. You will be seeing me again... very soon.

305131.text1: Empty threats, Elaadrin. Regardless of what happens to me now, my great work is done. Consider yourself lucky to be here at the eye of the storm, to witness the fruits of our labor.

305132.text: Wait... what is this place? How could such a place exist in the Windlord's realm?

305133.text: I think it's time for us to be leaving this place. I will open a portal to Valanaar.

305134.text1: Muln Earthfury of the Earthen Ring--the Windshapers would be happy to accept you as our guest.

305135.text: Yes, and you, Archmage Runeweaver. The High Order is eager to learn more of the Kirin Tor.

305508.text: Killed a peacekeeper and stole some windstones.
305508.text1: Killed a peacekeeper and stole some windstones.

305510.text: Why bother denying it, the constable already passed her judgement. No point lying.
305510.text1: Why bother denying it, the constable already passed her judgement. No point lying.

305512.text: Desperation? Hunger? I'm not exactly here doing this because I like robbing and murdering. I lost my home, had nowhere to go, and I don't much care to shave my head and worship some imaginary wind god, so I became a bandit. The rest is obvious.
305512.text1: Desperation? Hunger? I'm not exactly here doing this because I like robbing and murdering. I lost my home, had nowhere to go, and I don't much care to shave my head and worship some imaginary wind god, so I became a bandit. The rest is obvious.

305514.text:
Most of my outfit did. Displaced from the ground falling out from under our feet. Some came from other islands entirely. I came from the city of Shen'dramar, on the big island. Well, what used to be the big island, I suppose.

My family and I managed to get on one of the last skycutters out of there before the entire island broke apart. We thought that Zephras would save us. Well, it didn't. They are all long dead and now I'm here, awaiting execution.
305514.text1:
Most of my outfit did. Displaced from the ground falling out from under our feet. Some came from other islands entirely. I came from the city of Shen'dramar, on the big island. Well, what used to be the big island, I suppose.

My family and I managed to get on one of the last skycutters out of there before the entire island broke apart. We thought that Zephras would save us. Well, it didn't. They are all long dead and now I'm here, awaiting execution.

305516.text: Largely, yes. The thing we all have in common is that we have nowhere else to go and that we prefer thieving over enslaving ourselves to some insane cult.
305516.text1: Largely, yes. The thing we all have in common is that we have nowhere else to go and that we prefer thieving over enslaving ourselves to some insane cult.

305849.text: High Priestess, we are ready to carry out your will. I will move on the western watchtower, and Commander Cyclas will lead the attack on Shen'dar Village. Both will be ours by tomorrow.
305849.text1: High Priestess, we are ready to carry out your will. I will move on the western watchtower, and Commander Cyclas will lead the attack on Shen'dar Village. Both will be ours by tomorrow.

305850.text1: The great work is nearly complete, Skypriest Aanders. Your success here is vital.

305851.text: Of course, High Priestess. We are the instruments of your will. I only wish you could be here to witness our triumph firsthand.
305851.text1: Of course, High Priestess. We are the instruments of your will. I only wish you could be here to witness our triumph firsthand.

305852.text1: I am needed elsewhere for now and this represents but one piece on the gameboard. Do not fail me, Aanders.

305854.text: Do you seek the blessings of the Windlord?
305854.text1: Do you seek the blessings of the Windlord?

306266.text1:
Cooking on Zephras may seem difficult to the untrained eye, but I enjoy the creation of every dish. Even though our dwindling home is lacking many of our traditional kaldorei ingredients, it has been fun to create new variations of the recipes of our ancestors.

I hope that no matter where the winds take you, these recipes remind you of home.

306273.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause. I was in the middle of some important work.
306273.text1: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause. I was in the middle of some important work.

306274.text: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?
306274.text1: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?

306276.text: Ah, hello. You look as though you have a question for me.
306276.text1: Ah, hello. You look as though you have a question for me.

306278.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?
306278.text1: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

306554.text: When you find yourself in the port of Valanaar, seek out Elaadrin Evengale. He can tell you more of how we plan to do this.

306574.text: $n, ensure any allies with you are prepared and speak with me when you are ready to confront Lorthuna.

306593.text: <The gaze of the ranger standing before you is fixed on the enormous anchor pylon in the distance.>
306593.text1: <The gaze of the ranger standing before you is fixed on the enormous anchor pylon in the distance.>

307118.text:
<Before you lies the corpse of Jorel Windsinger.

Deep lacerations are cut into his legs, and lightning burns scorch his fur.

It is clear he put up a fight before succumbing to his wounds.>
307118.text1:
<Before you lies the corpse of Jorel Windsinger.

Deep lacerations are cut into his legs, and lightning burns scorch his fur.

It is clear he put up a fight before succumbing to his wounds.>

307912.text: Watch yourself, $c. The Windshapers will not tolerate hostility from the High Order.
307912.text1: Watch yourself, $c. The Windshapers will not tolerate hostility from the High Order.

307944.text: Check back in with the High Order here periodically. We may have tasks for you to take up from time to time. Until then, good luck on your adventures!

309474.text:
<Before you lies a skyborne; his body is mangled and bruised but still recognizable. It is clear he met a gruesome end while attempting to flee.

It appears that all of his belongings are still on his body, and a half-filled crate nearby lies spilled on the ground.>

309828.text: Wind's greetings, friend. I've been authorized to offer fellow Skyborne quick passage to the city of Stormwind. Please feel free to utilize this portal at your leisure.

312713.text: It can get boring up here, you know. I can only annoy that stuffy wretch Halaan so much before even that gets old.
312713.text1: It can get boring up here, you know. I can only annoy that stuffy wretch Halaan so much before even that gets old.

313248.text: Go on and have a seat near the fire and we can get started.

313249.text: All you need to start a camp of your own is a basic campfire. Cooks can generally teach you how to make one of those.

313250.text: Once your campfire is down, you can place all sorts of camp fixtures around it.

313251.text: Sufficiently skilled leatherworkers, for example, can place a tent like this one behind me.

313253.text: Every trade has something they can contribute to your camp, even fishermen!

313254.text: Then, all you need to do is have a seat near the fire and soak it all in. After a few minutes of resting, you'll gain various boons that will help you in your travels.

313255.text: If you just sit still and rest for a few more moments, you'll gain a benefit from having rested near the tent I have set up behind me.

313256.text: That's about the gist of it. Once you've gained your boon from resting near the fire, speak with me again.

313458.text:
The Al'Aketh cult claims that Al'Akir the "Windlord" will save us from our current woes here on Zephras. If Al'Akir is real and really is the ruler of Skywall, why did the wind spirits refuse to speak of him for so long?

Either he isn't real, or even worse, he's real and he's not as benevolent as the cult claims him to be. Either way, nothing about what the cult is doing is good for us normal folk.
313458.text1:
The Al'Aketh cult claims that Al'Akir the "Windlord" will save us from our current woes here on Zephras. If Al'Akir is real and really is the ruler of Skywall, why did the wind spirits refuse to speak of him for so long?

Either he isn't real, or even worse, he's real and he's not as benevolent as the cult claims him to be. Either way, nothing about what the cult is doing is good for us normal folk.

313648.text: The Nightclaw do not take kindly to reckless intruders. Tread carefully while in Shadowgale, $c.

314601.text: Wait, yes... this crystal! Valennia, is this...

314602.text1: ...a recall crystal! Used to record an important moment, no doubt.

314603.text: This is surely what the turncoat hoped to offer us in exchange for our protection.

314604.text1: The recall crystal is badly damaged, though. The recording is likely to be incomplete, so we must listen carefully.

314605.text: Activate it, Valennia. We need to learn as much as we can about what it contains.

314606.text1: ...do not delay. Muster our forces to march immediately. The pylons are key and...the wards...come down. This is...

314607.text1: ...quickly. With our forces.....will be exposed.....my ritual must not....

314608.text1: I alone am.....this task....the Windlord will.......our voices.....he will come.....we must not fail!

314609.text1: The crystal is too damaged to play any further, I am afraid.

314610.text: Wards... what is this about wards, Valennia?

314611.text1: The anchor pylons keep us suspended in this realm, but they also act as wards! The Shal'nan once spoke of this. They keep us shielded from...

314612.text: ...whatever else is out there in Skywall. Spirits save us... this is her plan. Bring down the wards and let her 'Windlord' in!

316310.text: It is vital that we learn more about what the cult is planning, and with the turncoat dead, the information may have died with him...

316364.text1:
I suppose that is true. I and the rest of my elites used to belong to an order known as the Empyrean Blades. We were the personal guard of our former leader, the Shal'nan. 

In the current, uncertain times we do what we can to help lead the peacekeepers' citizen militia, since we are the closest thing to professional soldiers left on Zephras.

316366.text1:
<Valennia looks away briefly before looking hesitantly back in your direction.>

The Shal'nan was the very best of us. It was he who stood up for our people against madness and oppression in Eldre'Thalas nearly ten thousand years ago. It was the Shal'nan who led us across the uncharted sea to escape the murderous vengeance of our ancient enemies.

It was the Shal'nan who brokered the pact of friendship with the wind spirits that allowed us to ascend to Skywall... and survive.

He was ever the servant leader to his people, even after he abdicated his position of power and retired.

316368.text1:
I might be the only living shen'dorei left amongst our people who had more than a handful of words with him.

I served him as the captain of his Empyrean Blades for nearly nine centuries, right up until... he left us.

Even still, I can't rightly claim that I "knew" him. He was ever a reserved and solitary man. He spent most of his time alone or in communion with the spirits in the spires high above the Shrine of the Four Winds... the place that the cult now calls the 'Shrine of Akir'.

316370.text1:
If I knew that then I suspect that life here on Zephras would be much, much easier. So many of our struggles and conflicts revolve around that very mystery.

I appreciate your curiosity on this matter but I'm afraid that is all I have to say about this for today.

316402.text: I can teach you to swing a blacksmith's hammer, if you are willing to learn.
316402.text1: I can teach you to swing a blacksmith's hammer, if you are willing to learn.

316461.text: Be careful, $c. There are cultists nearby.

317261.text: It's good to see you again, Danitha. It's only been a few years, but it feels like an ocean of time has passed.

317262.text1: Indeed it does, Leonid. I've enjoyed our correspondence, but it pleases me that you finally made the trip out to Bandarion Keep in person.

317263.text: I am glad I came to see what you've built here. Garek would be proud. This was no social call, though, Danitha. Surely you know that...

317264.text1: Ah, so we are cutting straight to the point, then?

317265.text: Yes. Have you considered Lord Tyrosus's offer? The Argent Dawn is prepared to welcome you and your people with open arms.

317266.text1: I'm sorry, Leonid, but I must decline. Much has changed but the Forsaken are still the people we swore to protect.

317267.text: But they fear and hate you, Danitha. Surely you know that? Among the Argent Dawn your connection to the light would be an asset. You would be highly valued!

317268.text1: No, Leonid. Our place is here. Our fledgling order must find our identity amongst our kind. I know how you feel about the Forsaken... that our 'condition' is something to be cured.

317269.text1: I reject that notion. This is who we are now, and we will make the Forsaken see that we are not what they think we are. We can be of service to Lordaeron again.

317270.text: Very well, Danitha. Just take care of yourselves. Many Forsaken cannot let go of the pain they suffered at the hands of the living wielders of the light. Their mistrust of paladins runs deep.

317271.text1: That is why it is so important that we stay.

317273.text1: Enough of this talk. I want to speak of the good times. Garek would have wanted that for us.

317287.text: They named it Bandarion Keep. I wonder what Garek would make of that?

321197.text: Welcome to the Bank of Valanaar. We can secure your belongings and valuables here should you so desire. Do you wish to access your deposit box?
321197.text1: Welcome to the Bank of Valanaar. We can secure your belongings and valuables here should you so desire. Do you wish to access your deposit box?

321203.text:
You've earned a degree of trust amongst the Nightclaw, $c. We don't have much to offer you as a reward, but we have managed to scavenge a number of crafting plans from the ruins of Ban'aethal.

The magesmiths of Ban'aethal were widely regarded to be the best artisans in all of the Skyborne Isles. The Nightclaw are naturalists, not crafters, so these records are of little use to us.

Continue to prove yourself to be a valuable ally, and I would make these secrets available to you.

321408.text:
Greetings, $c. Are you in need of arms?

I was trained by Antarion of Ban'aethal, using secrets handed down from the ancient master magesmiths of Kalimdor.

You'll find no finer weapons on Zephras Isle than mine.
321408.text1:
Greetings, $c. Are you in need of arms?

I was trained by Antarion of Ban'aethal, using secrets handed down from the ancient master magesmiths of Kalimdor.

You'll find no finer weapons on Zephras Isle than mine.

321669.text: Please clean yourself before handling our tomes.

323922.text:
Yes, I am the renowned trader who magnanimously fed the uh, starving... children...? ...of the Undercity during the recent war with the Scourge. Yes, I am the visionary businessgob and logistical genius who single-handedly armed the resistance and allowed our Dark Lady to found her nation of smelly corpses... um, I mean, "Forsaken."

Yep, I'm him. Glix Xizzix. I'd be happy to sign an autograph. For a small fee, of course.

What am I doing here running a barbershop, you ask? Well I got one word for you, bub--diversification. You've got to keep your revenue streams diversified!

324145.text1: All of the skyborne islands became destabilized and began to move apart a few years ago. If that wasn't bad enough, now large pieces of Zephras are beginning to fall away. It's hard to imagine your home falling into the sky, but that is my reality now.

324559.text: Supreme Magister, the Grand Skyseer would hear nothing of our grievance and in fact, reiterated her threat to us.
324559.text1: Supreme Magister, the Grand Skyseer would hear nothing of our grievance and made it quite clear that her threat to us stands.

324561.text: She dares make threats against us after her lackeys massacre our people in the highlands?

324562.text: I don't know who is more dangerous, the Al'Aketh, or the sky-cursed Windshapers! So be it. If she is not willing to resolve this with civility, we will not hesitate once the current crisis is over.

324563.text: For now, spread the word to our people. Be on your guard around Windshapers. We didn't start this fight, but once the cult is dealt with, we will be ready to end it.

325810.text: Greetings, citizen. How may I help you today?

325812.text:
Ah yes, he mentioned that an agent of the High Order would be arriving in Stormwind soon. He asked me to draft instructions for you.

<Randal hands you a neatly sealed note.>

This should give you all the information you need. You are in for quite the journey, $n. I wish you luck on behalf of Stormwind and the Alliance.

326162.text:
The Wind Spirits have left us. 

Now, only mindless echoes remain. Be wary, however. These winds are neither kind, nor gentle.
326162.text1:
The Wind Spirits have left us. 

Now, only mindless echoes remain. Be wary, however. These winds are neither kind, nor gentle.

326764.text:
It's my job to get the Paladins of Bandarion Keep set up with proper arms and armor. It's not much, but it's honest work.

I've got a thing or two for sale as well, should you need gear.
326764.text1:
It's my job to get the Paladins of Bandarion Keep set up with proper arms and armor. It's not much, but it's honest work.

I've got a thing or two for sale as well, should you need gear.

326948.text: I am Belanaa Windveil and I am an agent of the High Order here on Azeroth. If you'd like to make a donation of cloth to our organization, we would be most grateful.
326948.text1: I am Belanaa Windveil and I am an agent of the High Order here on Azeroth. If you'd like to make a donation of cloth to our organization, we would be most grateful.

326965.text: Our kind are rare these days, but there are those who still dream in emerald amongst the Shen'dorei.

327145.text: Board here for transport to Dalaran City, nestled in the Alterac Mountains.
